views.css: *{box-sizing:border-box}body{background:#fff}.app{margin:0 auto;background:#fff;color:#202124;font:14px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;border:1px solid #e4e5e7;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden}.jv-field{font:inherit;color:inherit;line-height:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;text-align:left;white-space:inherit;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere;cursor:text;border:0;border-radius:3px;padding:0;background:transparent}.jv-field:hover{background:#f1f3f5;outline:none!important}.jv-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5f65d8;outline-offset:3px}.sample-note{font-size:11px;color:#80848c;padding:13px 24px;margin:0;border-top:1px solid #f0f0f1}h1,h2,p{margin:0}.muted{color:#70757a}svg{vertical-align:middle;flex-shrink:0}@media(max-width:550px){.app{border-radius:6px}.sample-note{padding:12px 18px}}.slack{max-width:960px;color:#1d1c1d;font-size:15px}.channel-header{padding:17px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid #dedcde}.channel-header h1{font-size:19px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-.25px}.hash{color:#616061;font-weight:500;margin-right:3px}.day{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;margin:22px 0 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:650}.day:before,.day:after{content:"";height:1px;background:#e6e6e6;flex:1}.day>span{border:1px solid #dedede;border-radius:20px;padding:4px 16px;background:#fff}.messages{padding:4px 0 22px}.message{display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;padding:12px 24px}.message:hover{background:#f8f8f8}.avatar{height:36px;width:36px;border-radius:6px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;background:#e8daf1;color:#694b78}.avatar[title="U02DAN"]{background:#dae8f0;color:#3e6277}.avatar[title="U03ARIA"]{background:#f2ded4;color:#96654e}.message-content{min-width:0}.byline{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px}.byline strong{font-size:15px;font-weight:750}.time{font-size:12px;color:#616061}.message-text{line-height:1.48;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin:2px 0 7px;max-width:810px}.reactions{display:flex;gap:6px}.reaction{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;border:1px solid #c3deee;background:#e8f4fa;border-radius:14px;padding:1px 9px;font-size:12px;color:#1264a3;line-height:24px}.reaction>span:first-child{font-size:16px}.replies{font-size:12px;font-weight:650;color:#1264a3;margin-top:5px}.replies[title="0"]{display:none}.slack .sample-note{font-size:11px}@media(max-width:550px){.channel-header{padding:15px 18px}.message{padding:12px 16px}.byline{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px 7px}.message-text{font-size:14px}.byline strong{font-size:14px}}
